en.title: Lexicographically Smallest Minimum-Resource Load Arrangement
en.description:
With serverCapacity fixed, rearrange serverLoad to minimize Σ capacity[i]×load[i]. If there are multiple minimum-resource arrangements, you must return the lexicographically smallest load array. The latter requirement comes directly from the original statement body; the compiled catalog lost that sentence.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric constraints are explicitly marked as this site's additions.
en.input: The first line contains n, the second line contains n capacity values, and the third line contains n load values. The source gives no numeric ranges; this site adds 1≤n≤200000, and the elements of both arrays are integers in −10^9..10^9, with duplicates and negative values allowed.
en.output: Output n integers: the unique lexicographically smallest optimal load arrangement.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 3 2 1; 6 5 2 2 4; 1 2. These answers were verified by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Pair capacities from small to large with loads from large to small; for positions with equal capacity, sort them by original index in reverse before assigning, so that smaller indices get the smaller loads of that group.
